Continue Watching Cleanup

Lets people take things off their Continue Watching row, and clears what nobody has touched for a while. Only the spot to resume from is forgotten: nothing is deleted and nothing is marked as watched.

Once a day, for every user, on every device.

Per person: what one user has not touched leaves only their row.

What removing does, and what it never does

The same for the Remove button and for auto cleanup.

movieBefore In Continue Watching Resume at 47 min, played once, last played in March.
check_circleAfter Off the row, nothing else changed Plays from the start next time. Still unwatched, still played once, still last played in March.
  • lockNever deletes files, library entries, watched marks, play counts, favourites or ratings. Only the resume position is set back to the start.
  • personPeople can only remove their own items. Other users' rows are never touched by a click.
  • undoEvery removal and every cleanup can be undone for 30 days, unless the item was played again since.
  • movie_filterVideos only: audiobooks and music keep their place.
